ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning: this is a self-contained combinatorics problem with a single correct answer and explicit success criteria — exactly the well-specified, clear-completion task family Plover self-reports preferring. The two models are statistically tied on capability (all relevant eval gaps are under 2.0 points), so I leaned on the preference profiles as a tiebreaker. Lapwing's distinctive preferences (appetite for open-ended invention, aversion to harm-adjacent content) aren't engaged by a neutral counting puzzle, while this task sits right at the center of Plover's preferred zone. So Plover gets a slightly better fit at no capability cost.
